newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices, volume down on world trends.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices, volume down on world trends.

text.p: Prices and volume fell on Istanbul's gold exchange on Thursday due to slightly easier levels in Europe, dealers said.
Gold closed at $384.40 an ounce and 1,178,000 lira per gram against yesterday's $384.75 and 1,178,950 lira. Traded volume was down to 602 kilos after 875 kilos on Wednesday.
"There was mild free market demand in the morning but it faded in the afternoon due to expectations that the ounce would go further down to test $382.5 support abroad," a trader said.
Volume dived to 60 kilos in the second session from 542 in the first.
Some 68.4 percent of total trade was in lira terms, with no dollar deals in the afternoon.
